# Feature Request
## Problem Statement
A clear description of the problem this feature solves (e.g., "I can't track my session progress as a mentee"). Help us understand why this feature is needed.

## Proposed Solution
A clear description of how you think this feature should work. Include specific details about:
- What the feature does
- How users would interact with it
- Any UI/UX considerations

## Alternatives Considered
A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered, and why you believe your proposed solution is better.

## Design Assets
If you have mockups, wireframes, or design assets that illustrate the feature, please attach them here. This helps the team visualize the proposal.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, screenshots, or links to similar features in other projects that you think are relevant to this feature request.
